# Signalsmith Stretch (bundled)

Pitch shifting for Q-LiM (1.4.13). Header-only C++11, no SIMD intrinsics (builds for every Q-LiM target).

- signalsmith-stretch.h: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch commit 88061fd4eda56a2353c5d65c74aa3f4ccf76f9da (MIT, LICENSE-stretch.txt)
- linear/ (fft.h, stft.h only): https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear tag 0.6.6 (MIT, LICENSE-linear.txt)

Unchanged copies. Used only through src/pitchshift.cpp.
